newsitem.title: USA: Sept S&P 500 futures sail to record high close.
newsitem.headline: Sept S&P 500 futures sail to record high close.

text.p: July 16 - September S&P 500 stock index futures vaulted to another all-time high close, the second in as many days, settling at 942.30 on continued strength in technology shares and a rally in bonds. Sept S&Ps notched a new all-time high of 946.75 on the day. Market looking ahead to Thursday's release of Microsoft earnings.
